Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot


User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Title: Users' published copilot agent may not appear in the Teams Admin Center after a product app is published

User impact: User impact: Users' published copilot agent may not appear in the Teams Admin Center after a product app is published.

Current status: We're reviewing contextual details provided by your representatives to gain insight into the underlying source of impact and determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: Some users publishing copilot agents may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Friday, November 20, 2026, at 10:30 AM UTC

Title: Users' published copilot agent may not appear in the Teams Admin Center after a product app is published

User impact: Users' published copilot agent may not appear in the Teams Admin Center after a product app is published.

More info: As a workaround, admins can follow the below steps:

1) Manually compose the direct app URL: https://admin.teams.microsoft.com/policies/manage-apps/<App ID>

2) Obtain the required App ID using the Export option on the Manage apps page and downloading the CSV.

Current status: We’ve identified that a recent update to the Teams admin center introduced a client-side filtering issue that prevents some apps with agent capabilities from appearing within the Manage apps grid and search results. The affected apps remain available in the app catalog and can still be accessed directly. We’ve developed and validated a fix in our internal environments and are preparing to deploy it to the affected production environment, which is expected to complete by mid-December. 

Scope of impact: Some users publishing copilot agents may be impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A recent update to the Teams admin center introduced a client-side filtering issue that prevents some apps with agent capabilities from appearing within the Manage apps grid and search results. 

Next update by: Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 11:00 AM UTC
